aggregation: h(C,O) = mu + a*C + b*O + d*C*O. The within-scenario paired difference gives 2a + 2d*o, so averaging over both orders cancels d exactly and leaves the pure condition main effect. One order per pair, which a parity-locked generator forces, folds the requested-line effect into the direction
